B1t.description: Fine-tune the class-9 head row and bias (gradients); positives = the k examples, negatives = replayed class 0-8 training images.

B2t.description: Fine-tune the whole model with replay (gradients); k positives and 59 replayed class 0-8 training images per step; BatchNorm statistics frozen; adapter stays zero.

B0b.description: B0 imprinting with the class-9 bias chosen from a grid (no gradients).

selection.data: VALIDATION split, seeds 0-7. Class-9 validation images exclude the k examples of each seed. Precision is computed over all class 0-8 validation images and the remaining class-9 validation images.
selection.per_setting_score: mean over seeds 0-7 of (new-class accuracy + class-9 precision) / 2, in %. Precision is 0 if nothing is predicted as class 9.
selection.constraint: mean over seeds 0-7 of the old-class drop (base old-class validation accuracy minus the condition's) <= 2 points.
selection.choice: One global setting per condition: the highest score among settings that meet the constraint. Ties are broken by the smaller old-class drop, then by the earlier setting in grid order. If no setting meets the constraint, the setting with the smallest mean old-class drop is chosen and this is reported.
selection.test: The chosen setting is evaluated once on the TEST split for seeds 0-7. No other setting is evaluated on TEST.
